content: Since I've been in the queue for getting a Steam Controller for quite some time I never imagined I would get accepted into the Steam Machine one this year and added myself into the list "just in case", but got the e-mail yesterday and I'm not really sure. Really overpriced but tempting at the same time, anyone has one and want to talk me out of it (or into it?).
